email.subject1: a signal play for Remodel Health
email.body1:
John, saw Remodel Health posted over 150% ICHRA sales growth and just ran its largest AIM conference yet.

Growth like that usually means more in-market employers and brokers in play than your BD team can cover, and that is where good accounts go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Remodel Health off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
John, quick follow-up for Remodel Health.

After a year of 150% growth, the next number gets set high, and most BD teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit it. The gap surfaces late, when recovering the quarter is already a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Remodel Health needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
John, last bit of proof for Remodel Health.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Remodel Health's reply rate likely compares to other fast-growing health-tech companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
John, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters most after a breakout year, and I know running BD on a fast-growing team is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a health-tech motion? I will tailor it to Remodel Health either way.
